title: Random Mods Downloader
description: A chaotic Fabric 1.19-1.21 mod that downloads completely random mods from Modrinth via the /acceptmods command
body:
# 🎲 Random Mods Downloader — Pure Chaos for Minecraft!

> *Note: This project was formerly known as Randoms Mods.*

Ever felt like Minecraft became too predictable? Random Mods Downloader injects pure chaos into your game by downloading completely random mods from Modrinth directly into your client. Every restart is a brand new, unpredictable experience!

---

### 🔥 What's New in This Version?
* Project Renamed: Updated from *Randoms Mods* to *Random Mods Downloader* to better reflect its core purpose.
* Massive Update: Upgraded filters are now fully optimized and ready to download 300+ mods with almost zero errors!
* Extended Compatibility: Fully supported and tested on Minecraft versions from 1.19 up to 1.21.

---

### 🚀 How It Works (Beta Stage)
1. Launch the game and join any world.
2. Open the chat and type the command: /acceptmods
3. Wait for the download. As soon as a random mod is selected, its Name, Author, and License will be outputted directly into your chat.
4. Restart your game to apply the changes and start your chaotic run!

⚠️ CRITICAL WARNING: By typing /acceptmods, you explicitly agree that the mod will immediately start downloading files from Modrinth to your computer without further confirmation prompts. Use at your own risk!

---

### 🛠 Current Beta Limitations & Features
* Immediate Download: After entering the command, the mod starts downloading files instantly without an additional confirmation dialog.
* Upgraded Dependency Resolver: Features an automatic dependency downloader. Thanks to the new filters, it now successfully handles over 300+ mods with significantly fewer errors, though some rare crashes due to missing libraries may still occur as this is a Beta.

---
